checks.name: 器件精确查询
checks.command: puts [version -short]; puts [get_parts -quiet xc7z020clg400-2]; puts [get_parts -quiet xc7z020clg400-2I]; puts [get_parts -quiet XC7Z020-2CLG400I]; foreach p [get_parts -quiet xc7z020clg400-2] {puts [list NAME [get_property NAME $p] FAMILY [get_property FAMILY $p] DEVICE [get_property DEVICE $p] PACKAGE [get_property PACKAGE $p] SPEED [get_property SPEED $p]]}; puts [get_parts -quiet xc7z020*clg400*-2*]
checks.reason: MCP返回原生Tcl0，唯一Vivado器件xc7z020clg400-2及DEVICE/PACKAGE/SPEED与用户指定对应。

limitations: I温度后缀保留用户资料事实，工具目录及JTAG不能证明实物速度/温度。
